title: Heliostat Etcher
pages: Resonate quartz to attuned quartz, mill four glass panes into optic powder in the Milling Gantry, then craft the etcher with a sealed steel plate in the top-right slot, a Dawn Emblem in the bottom-left slot, that quartz, one optic powder (left middle), a Corona Ember from the Corona Collector (right middle), a Heliograph Plate from the Enamel Kiln (center) and a resonance infuser. This is the t5 to t6 craft gate; plain glass panes no longer satisfy it. Its upper-left plate is Solar Tempered Plate from the Solar Smelter. The Dawn Emblem comes from an Astral Font rite: offer two more attuned quartz to a font holding at least 240 lumen. The separate attuned quartz slot remains mandatory.
Keep the block directly below open sky and operate during daylight.  Work pauses without spending FE when daylight or sky access is lost. The solar prism is the next progression material.

Twenty-seven datapack etching recipes make useful glass, lighting, navigation, redstone and decorative items. Under open daylight, two forge:ingots/rhenium etch into a comparator, two forge:ingots/rhodium into a target, and two forge:ingots/ruthenium into an observer. Each takes 120 ticks at 16 FE/t. An Encoder Ring Blank etches into a Graduated Encoder Ring (200 ticks, 20 FE/t) for rotary angle feedback. One Stainless Vessel Stock etches into a straight Graduated Linear Scale (220 ticks, 20 FE/t) for the Lattice Scriber's linear travel feedback. These sunlit-mask graduation steps are game choices; the two scales are not interchangeable. JEI shows counts, results, FE and the daylight condition. Recipe type: arcana_industry:etching; fields ingredient, count, result, duration, energy_per_tick and optional priority. A Platinum Sensor Blank etches into a Platinum Resistance Probe (220 ticks, 20 FE/t) for the Stellar Crucible thermal sensor gate. A Photodiode Blank (a glass pane over a Germanium Wafer over one forge:ingots/indium, stacked in a crafting column) etches into a Photodetector Cell (200 ticks, 18 FE/t): the sunlit mask patterns its electrode comb. The Lens Collimator needs that cell.

Top and horizontal faces import; bottom exports. Each side is configurable in the GUI. Supply 16 FE/t or use the manual crank. Inventory, FE, progress and port modes persist; breaking drops inventory.

Five prismarine crystals etch into one sea lantern; rinsing, resonating and scoring return at most five crystals per lantern. Six copper ingots etch into two lightning rods, matching the three-ingot recovery limit per rod. Two glow ink sacs etch into one glow item frame; Phase Diffuser recovery yields one sac per frame. Sunlight frosts one glass into one white stained glass, etches six sand straight into sixteen glass panes, and tints eight red sand into eight orange stained glass without dye.
